reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and holiday adjustment helpers, but independently implements daily occurrence filtering in both server handlers alongside getNextDate.

duplication.why: Daily skip policy appears in three implementations, and the budget loop repeats its expanded adjustment dispatch.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but daily scheduling policy also lives in server handlers and budget orchestration.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on schedule occurrence handling, the range endpoint, holidays, and associated tests and documentation.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several occurrence-processing implementations, while the new handler leaves config untyped despite an existing RecurConfig type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getDatesInRange and getUpcomingDates iterate raw occurrences and independently implement daily skipping instead of sharing the policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily skipping is reshaped into findWeekdayOccurrence in getNextDate, a collecting loop in getUpcomingDates, and a continue branch in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: A holidays parameter is added to each weekend adjustment helper; getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, while getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange implement that policy independently.
